title: In This World Broken Things Heal When You Tell The Truth
description: Kaito broke his dad's pocket watch three days ago, and in this world it only heals when he admits it. What's the one thing you never confessed? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Kaito: 11-year-old Japanese boy, messy short black hair with a cowlick, faded red hooded sweatshirt over a white T-shirt, navy shorts, white socks, no hat
characters.Dad: 41-year-old Japanese father named Masaru, short black hair graying at the sides, light stubble, rolled-up sleeves on a plain olive work shirt, dark canvas apron, brown trousers, no hat, no glasses
characters.Mai: 8-year-old Japanese girl, Kaito's little sister, black hair in two low pigtails with plain yellow hair ties, pink sweater, gray skirt, white socks, no hat

scenes.say: In this world, broken things heal the second you tell the person you hurt the truth. Kaito has been hiding a broken pocket watch under his bed for three days.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside a small 1990s Japanese boy's bedroom at night, Kaito lies on his futon staring at the ceiling, wide awake. [4-7s] In the same small bedroom, Kaito reaches under his bed frame and pulls out a small cloth bundle. [7-10s] In the same small bedroom, close-up of Kaito's hands unwrapping a silver pocket watch with a cracked glass face, his eyes guilty.

scenes.say: He knows the rule works. Last spring he broke Mai's favorite cup, said sorry, and the pieces jumped back together. But this watch was Grandpa's, and Grandpa is gone.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In a small 1990s Japanese kitchen, flashback, Kaito bows to Mai beside a broken white cup on the floor. [4-7s] In the same small kitchen, close-up of the cup shards sliding back together into one whole white cup with a soft glow, Mai gasping. [7-10s] Back in Kaito's small bedroom at night, close-up of the back of the silver pocket watch showing one small old dent, Kaito's thumb rubbing it.

scenes.say: So the watch is Dad's now, and Dad is the strictest man on their street. When he asks if anyone saw it, Kaito says the cat probably knocked it somewhere.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In Dad's small wooden workshop at the back of a 1990s Japanese house, Dad searches an empty shelf, brow furrowed. [4-7s] In the narrow hallway of the same small house, Dad turns to Kaito, who stands stiffly with his hands behind his back. [7-10s] In the same hallway, close-up of Kaito's face as he forces a small smile and glances at a sleeping gray cat on a cushion.

scenes.say: But every lie makes the crack spread a little further across the glass. By day three it nearly reaches the edge, so Kaito walks into the workshop to confess.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In Kaito's small bedroom, extreme close-up of a thin crack creeping slowly across the watch glass. [4-7s] In the narrow hallway, Kaito stands outside the half-open workshop door, gripping the watch in both hands, taking a deep breath. [7-10s] In Dad's small wooden workshop, Dad looks up from his workbench as Kaito steps inside holding out the cracked watch.

scenes.say: He tells Dad everything, and the glass heals in his hand. But the little dent stays. Dad goes quiet, then admits he made it at eleven and never told Grandpa.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In Dad's small wooden workshop, close-up of the cracked glass smoothing over into a clean whole face with a soft glow in Kaito's palm. [4-7s] In the same workshop, Dad turns the watch over and stares at the small old dent, his face softening. [7-10s] In the same workshop, Dad sits down on a stool and rubs the back of his neck, looking embarrassed, while Kaito stares at him in surprise.

scenes.say: So that night they kneel at Grandpa's altar, and Dad finally says it out loud. The dent smooths away. In this world, some broken things just wait thirty years.
scenes.video: [0-4s] In the tatami room of the same small house at night, Dad and Kaito kneel side by side before a small wooden family altar with one candle and a plain framed photo of a smiling old man. [4-7s] In the same tatami room, Dad bows his head low and speaks quietly, Kaito glancing at him. [7-10s] In the same tatami room, close-up of the silver pocket watch on the altar as the old dent on its back smooths away with a soft glow, the candle flickering.
